must_fix: CLARITY (must fix): b7 l18 "[sharply] Head Constable। इन दोनों को हिरासत में लीजिए।" does not say who is being taken. Only the DSP and Pushpa are in the b7 frames, and Pushpa is holding Nirala's chain. Bhaiyaji is never seen after b6 shot 4. So the branch's central payoff (Bhaiyaji and the SHO in custody, per cliffhanger_ladder s2a03) rests on a pronoun, and a viewer can hear it as Nirala plus Bhaiyaji. FIX: l18 text "[sharply] Head Constable। भैयाजी और SHO त्रिपाठी: दोनों को हिरासत में लीजिए।" (about 66 characters, +21; 'SHO त्रिपाठी' echoes the l11 register line). Change target_seconds 4.6 to 6.6 and target_total_seconds 129.1 to 131.1. The dialogue count goes to about 987, still under D-016 direction 7's 1,050. Optional, free: b8 shot 1 insert also shows the empty chief-guest chair with the marigold garland and the ring of godown keys left on the seat, beside Tripathi's spilled peanut cone, so both exits are in the picture.

STILLS-ONLY STAGING (must fix): b6 shot 2 carries l14 and all of l15, which is 3.2 + 7.2 = 10.4 s of target on one still. That breaks the 8 s shot ceiling (hinglish-screenwriting pacing rule), on Nirala's key line. medium: STILLS-ONLY STAGING (medium): b10 shot 1 says Nirala's cap is 'cap level', and his look locks it 'worn dead level'. Shot 3 says 'her fingers set his cap level'. Nothing changes between the stills, so the gesture behind 'Cap सीधी रखिए' does not read. Also, l26 is split across two shots of about 1.6 and 1.8 s at the softest moment. Optional: play all of l26 on shot 2 and move the cap insert into the silence after.

PERFORMABILITY (medium): 18 of 27 lines are tagged [calm], [flatly] or [quietly], including all 11 of Nandini's. The climax line l07 (naming the chief guest) rests on [flatly], which no Series 2 voice has confirmed. Casting tested Nandini only on [deadpan], [quietly]+[slowly] and [curt] (content/series2/casting/manifest.jsonl). Risk: the climax sounds robotic (plan section 1 failure test). Fix: if S10 finds Apsara ignores [flatly], swap it for [calm] as the writer notes say. Optional: if S10 confirms [curt] for her, use '[curt] और आठ सौ बोरी नहीं लौटेगी, DSP साहब।' (l20) so her one refusal to be rounded up has an edge without getting louder.

STAKES (medium, optional): the DSP's resistance is a covered mic and 'बाद में, Joshi।'. Nothing says what defying him costs her, so the 2.0 s pause in b7 is the only jeopardy and the finale plays as a run of wins. Optional: l05 "[quietly] बाद में, Joshi। आपकी transfer pending है।" (+26 characters, target 1.8 to 3.6 s). It also plants b9, where she turns the same transfer down. Only if the count allows: with must-fix 1 the total is about 1,013 characters.

CONTINUITY (minor): b1 shot 2 has the pair 'step in' through the front doorway, but s2a02 b12 shot 1 already brought them in through it at 9:55. Also, the red thick_file under Nirala's left arm in s2a02 b12 vanishes with no handover. Fix: b1 shot 2 'Nandini and Nirala step forward from beside the doorway into the open floor before the press table', and in b2 shot 3 the plum-cardigan sleeve also takes the red file (or he keeps it under his left arm to b6).

HINGLISH (minor, optional): in l02 'नक़ली Inspector: arrest।', the one-word 'arrest' after a colon reads like a caption. Optional: "[laughs] और ये रहा नक़ली Inspector, arrest हो गया। शाबाश, SI Joshi।". This is the bible's wording and a casting take of it exists (dsp_t2_hi), so let the voice director's ear decide. Also, 'almirah' in Latin script in Tripathi's l09 may come out as Indian-English 'al-MY-ra' where a UP speaker says अलमारी. It is the series word (s2a01), so change it only if the take sounds anglicised, and then everywhere.

METADATA (minor): ending_question is in English in the hi file (s2a02 is Hindi, s2a01 is English, so the series is inconsistent). The inserts b2 shot 3 and b9 shot 2 give hands only by character side ('her own left wrist', 'her right hand'), and D-013 rule 3 wants picture terms. Nothing says who holds Nirala's cuff from b7 to b10, and Pushpa needs both hands for the shield in b8. Add one state line.

LENGTH (note, no action): the targets look honest or generous, not optimistic. Two Series 2 casting takes use this script's exact words: dsp_t2_hi (the l02 words, with [proudly]) ran 5.44 s against a 6.0 s target, and reporter_t1_hi (l08) ran 3.36 s against 3.4 s.
